purpose: The strict text-like screen decides whether a surface window is promoted as a potential text-like signal, but its three constants live in source with no profile and no calibration record. This declaration states the sample each constant actually rests on.

bound_implementation.binding_note: This declaration binds the constants by value rather than the file by digest, so unrelated edits to the module do not break the audit while any change to a screen threshold does.

evidence_bindings.note: PHerc0139 at source_pixel_um 9.362: 15 candidates, 5 row bands, 2 rows with at least four candidates, histogram {1:3, 2:1, 3:1, 4:6, 5:4}. This is the single control that motivates all three constants.

The same frozen PHerc0139 window under three checkpoints: 15/2 (gp-scroll1, passes), 4/0 (large-scroll1), 2/0 (scroll5-pherc172). Two of the three checkpoints fail the screen on the acknowledged positive control.
1 candidate against a minimum of 10 and 0 qualifying rows against a minimum of 2. This is the evidence that cancelled the U1 relaxation.
20 candidates, 2 qualifying rows, in-domain for the scroll5-pherc172 checkpoint.

The only two designated hard negatives ever screened: PHerc1447 (5 candidates, 0 qualifying rows) and PHerc800 (4 candidates, 0 qualifying rows). Both were run under the large-scroll1 checkpoint, and this artifact's own status is REJECT_LARGE_MODEL.
47 unlabelled target windows under one checkpoint: 10 passed, 17 were rejected by the row term alone, 20 by both terms, and none by the candidate-count term alone.

calibration.note: The two labelled negatives measured 5 and 4 candidates, both far below 10, so no negative constrains the value from nearby. The lowest passing positive measured 15, so nothing in the corpus distinguishes 10 from any cut between 6 and 15.
Zero margin. The primary control's fifth row band holds exactly 4 candidates against a floor of 4; raising the floor to 5 would drop that row, leave one qualifying row, and fail the control outright.

Zero margin. The primary control produced exactly 2 qualifying rows against a floor of 2; raising the floor to 3 would fail the control. On the 47-window target pass this is the term that binds alone 17 times, while the candidate-count term never binds alone.

known_limitations: All three constants fall below the declared audit minimums on both sides: 7 positive measurements against a minimum of 10, and 2 negative measurements against a minimum of 5.
The 7 positive measurements are not 7 independent samples. They are 3 source artifacts across 2 scrolls, re-measured under 3 checkpoints.

Both labelled negatives were screened only under the large-scroll1 checkpoint, and that checkpoint was itself rejected (REJECT_LARGE_MODEL). On the canonical timesformer-gp-scroll1 lane that produced the positive control, negative_n is 0: no designated negative control has ever been run through this screen with the checkpoint the screen is operated with.
Two of the three constants have zero margin on the single control that motivates them, so the screen cannot be tightened at all without failing its own positive control.

The source comment states that the candidate count and not the row term is what binds, citing the U0 control. That generalisation is not supported: across the 47-window target pass the row term was the sole binding term 17 times and the candidate-count term was never the sole binding term.
The 253 further screened windows are unlabelled target surfaces with no ground truth and are not counted as negatives here.
A window that fails this screen is not evidence of absence of ink or text, and a window that passes is not accepted ink, text, letters, or First Letters.
